metadata.title: Minimalist Pop Album Cover with Geometric Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A clean, high-key centered portrait featuring a subject seated on a textured geometric object with large-scale, airy geometric typography and soft pastel accents.
excludeWhen: dark or moody lighting is required
busy or cluttered backgrounds are requested
serif or handwritten primary display text is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered full-body portrait of a person sitting cross-legged on a cube covered in fine script, set against a seamless white studio background. The top third of the frame is occupied by large, thin geometric lettering with a subtle purple-to-pink gradient.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical alignment between the central subject and the stacked typography
Contrast between the large, clean display type and the dense, small-scale script on the cube
Soft pastel color accents against a dominant white and neutral gray palette
Symmetrical balance anchored by the central cube
coreInvariants: High-key, seamless white background with soft floor reflection
Geometric sans-serif typography with wide tracking
Subject seated atop a geometric pedestal

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally and vertically in the lower two-thirds of the frame, scaled to approximately 40% of the height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The cube pedestal serves as the primary visual anchor for the subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large display text at the top, moves down to the subject's face, and rests on the textured cube.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space surrounding the subject and text to emphasize a clean, airy aesthetic.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and Dark Gray (Subject's clothing and cube script)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Lavender and Pink (Gradient in the display typography)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (bright) with low saturation, except for the subtle pastel gradient.

letterConstructionRules: Open or stylized 'A' without a crossbar
Inverted or mirrored characters for stylistic effect
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'A' is rendered as a simple chevron or caret shape
The letter 'Y' features a long, straight vertical stem
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Large geometric display type paired with a smaller, wide-tracked version of the same style for the subtitle.
graphicDevices: Fine-line script texture on the pedestal

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the geometric base for the circular characters.
Offers the clean, modern proportions required for the layout.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-key studio photograph of a person sitting cross-legged on a light gray cube. The cube is covered in a dense, small-scale handwritten script pattern. The background is seamless white with a soft reflection on the floor.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, ultra-light geometric sans-serif text at the top. The main title should have a subtle lavender-to-pink gradient. Below it, add a subtitle in the same font but smaller, with extremely wide tracking and stylized/mirrored characters.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white and seamless?
Is the typography ultra-light and geometric?
Is the tracking on the subtitle wide enough to span the width of the main title?
Does the cube feature a dense script texture?

adjustableVariables: Density of the script on the pedestal
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for monolinear stroke weight in text
Ensure the gradient is subtle and not banded
Verify the subject is perfectly centered
Confirm the script on the cube is legible as texture but not distracting
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key centered portrait + Geometric pedestal with texture + Large-scale hairline geometric typography with wide tracking.
